data_route: dsImaging admission of image_root asset plus per-image metadata declaring pathology label, label levels and patient privacy unit; three DSLite custodians.

evaluation.aggregation: arithmetic mean and sample SD across three seeds
evaluation.alternative: None selected; no scored primary run or alternative was attempted.
evaluation.diagnostic: AUC > 0.5 and accuracy > held-out majority-class rate; report per-replicate and three-seed mean comparison.
evaluation.test_policy: Do not inspect held-out labels/images or score models before settings are fixed. One scoring pass for each trained replicate; never change a scored configuration.
twins: identical frozen backbone and head, same split and schedule, centrally without DP

model.bounds_policy: Released image transform and fixed feature totalization; no data-derived feature bounds.
model.head: linear 512 to 2; cross_entropy

model_params_policy: Unchanged v0.5.0 registry defaults; no schedule search.
patient_training: Released runner averages frozen features within patient and takes deterministic modal label before patient DP-SGD. Source pathology labels are consistent within patient according to archived audit.

split.policy: Reuse byte-identical segmentation split JSON for each seed; split-v1 SHA256 patient ordering, first floor(n/5) patients held out, sites-v1 hash ordering dealt across three sites.
split.split_source: Archived segmentation provenance; pod files not yet verified.
